[codex/claude generated]

## Motivation

DeepEP 2.5 (deepseek-ai/DeepEP#763) removes the V1 `Buffer` API and NVSHMEM, and replaces `ElasticBuffer` with `EPBuffer`, `EngramBuffer`, `PPBuffer`, and `BucketBuffer`. SGLang still needs V1 for the `deepep` backend, so it cannot replace the existing `sgl-deep-ep` package (V1 + DeepEP 2.1, built from `sgl-project/DeepEP@sgl-deepep`).

DeepEP 2.5 is instead packaged separately as `sgl-deep-ep-v25`, built from the new [`sgl-project/DeepEP@sgl-deepep-v25`](https://github.com/sgl-project/DeepEP/tree/sgl-deepep-v25) branch: upstream DeepEP 2.5, plus the manylinux `pidfd` fix and an `sgl_deep_ep_v25/` packaging directory. That wheel installs the Python package `deep_ep_v25`, and its host extension is compiled with the C++ `deep_ep` namespace renamed. As a result, `deep_ep` and `deep_ep_v25` can be installed in, and imported into, the same process. This PR adds the release pipeline for it; the `sgl-deep-ep` release is unchanged.

## Modifications

- `.github/workflows/release-whl-deepep-v25.yml`: a manual release workflow modeled on `release-whl-deepep.yml`.
  - Same Python (3.11/3.12/3.13) x architecture (x86_64/aarch64) matrix; it builds `sgl-deepep-v25` by default.
  - Builds with the CUDA 13.4 manylinux builder, because DeepEP 2.5 needs a CUDA 13.1+ toolkit to build and to JIT-compile kernels at runtime. PyTorch 2.14.1 comes from the cu130 index, matching the SGLang runtime; the extension needs only CUDA 13.
  - Uploads wheels to the `sgl-project/whl` release `sgl-deep-ep-v25-v<version>`. The prefix keeps them out of the `v0.1.x` releases that other packages share.
  - Updates the `cu134/sgl-deep-ep-v25` index.
  - Publishes to PyPI with a new `SGL_DEEP_EP_V25_PYPI_TOKEN` secret.
- `docker/sgl-deep-ep-v25.Dockerfile`:
  - Installs `nvidia-nccl-cu13==2.32.3` with `--no-deps`, because DeepEP 2.5 needs NCCL 2.32.3+ and PyTorch pins an older version.
  - Adds the elfutils headers, which DeepJIT includes. `libdw` is only `dlopen`ed at runtime, if it is present.
  - Drops the NVSHMEM and RDMA build dependencies.
- `scripts/build_sgl_deepep_v25.sh`:
  - Builds in that image and runs `auditwheel repair` without the NVSHMEM/gdrcopy excludes.
  - Writes PyPI wheels that drop the local CUDA version.
- `scripts/update_deepep_whl_index.py`: adds `--package` and `--release-tag-prefix`. The defaults keep the current `sgl-deep-ep` behavior.

SGLang runtime code is unchanged; this PR adds no dependency or import. Switching `deepep_v2` to `deep_ep_v25` will be a follow-up, after the first release.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable (release tooling only).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. The package itself was validated with a wheel built from `sgl-deepep-v25` with the same packaging script, outside this workflow, on 4x GB300 (aarch64). The environment was CUDA 13.1 toolkit, PyTorch 2.14.1 cu130, and NCCL 2.32.3:

- `import deep_ep_v25` works, and the wheel contains only `deep_ep_v25`. With only nvcc 13.0 available, the import fails with a clear prerequisite error.
- `deep_ep` (`sgl-deep-ep`, DeepEP 2.1) and `deep_ep_v25` import into one process in either order, with distinct pybind11 types.
- `tests/ep/test_ep.py` on 4 GPUs, NVLink only (`EP_DISABLE_GIN=1`): all 36 correctness cases pass; dispatch/combine run at ~840 GB/s.
- RDMA was not validated. Gin setup failed on that host with an IB-level `IBV_WC_RETRY_EXC_ERR` before any DeepEP kernel ran.

Release tooling checks:

- Both `cuda13.4` builder images put GCC 13 on `PATH`. DeepJIT needs `<format>`, so this matters.
- The shell scripts, including the in-container script, pass `bash -n`, and the workflow YAML parses.
- `update_deepep_whl_index.py` produces the same `sgl-deep-ep` index as before. In a run with both packages' wheels, each index lists only its own package. `ruff`, `ruff format`, and `isort` are clean.
- The builder image and the workflow have not run end to end yet. The first dispatch should use an rc version.

Before the first release:

- Add the `SGL_DEEP_EP_V25_PYPI_TOKEN` repository secret. The `sgl-deep-ep-v25` name is still unregistered on PyPI, so the first upload needs an account-scoped token, or a pending trusted publisher with a matching workflow change.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

detail.title: [CI] deepep: Add release workflow for sgl-deep-ep-v25 (DeepEP 2.5)

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,157 @@
+name: Release sgl-deep-ep-v25
+
+on:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      version:
+        description: "Public wheel version (for example, 0.1.0 or 0.1.1rc0)"
+        type: string
+        required: true
+      deepep-ref:
+        description: "DeepEP ref containing the implementation and sgl_deep_ep_v25 package"
+        type: string
+        required: false
+        default: "sgl-deepep-v25"
+
+concurrency:
+  group: release-sgl-deep-ep-v25
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+
+env:
+  TORCH_VERSION: "2.14.1"
+  # PyTorch's CUDA build; the extension only needs CUDA 13. The wheels are built with the
+  # CUDA 13.4 toolkit; DeepEP 2.5 needs CUDA 13.1+ for the build and for runtime JIT.
+  TORCH_CUDA_TAG: "cu130"
+  RELEASE_TAG: sgl-deep-ep-v25-v${{ inputs.version }}
+
+jobs:
+  build-cu134-matrix:
+    if: github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang'
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        python-version: ["3.11", "3.12", "3.13"]
+        arch: [x86_64, aarch64]
+        include:
+          - arch: x86_64
+            runner: x64-kernel-build-node
+          - arch: aarch64
+            runner: arm-kernel-build-node
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Clean workspace
+        run: |
+          docker run --rm -v "${{ github.workspace }}:/workspace" alpine:3 \
+            sh -c 'rm -rf /workspace/..?* /workspace/.[!.]* /workspace/*' || true
+
+      - name: Checkout SGLang
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Checkout DeepEP
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          repository: sgl-project/DeepEP
+          ref: ${{ inputs['deepep-ref'] || 'sgl-deepep-v25' }}
+          path: DeepEP-source
+          submodules: recursive
+
+      - name: Build wheels
+        env:
+          SGL_DEEP_EP_V25_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
+        run: |
+          bash scripts/build_sgl_deepep_v25.sh \
+            "${{ matrix.python-version }}" \
+            "13.4" \
+            "${{ github.workspace }}/DeepEP-source" \
+            "${{ matrix.arch }}"
+
+      - name: Upload CUDA-tagged wheel
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: deepep-v25-wheel-cu134-py${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
+          path: DeepEP-source/dist/*.whl
+          if-no-files-found: error
+
+      - name: Upload PyPI wheel
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: deepep-v25-pypi-cu134-py${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
+          path: DeepEP-source/dist-pypi/*.whl
+          if-no-files-found: error
+
+  release-whl:
+    needs: build-cu134-matrix
+    if: |
+      github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang' &&
+      needs.build-cu134-matrix.result == 'success'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout SGLang
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Download CUDA-tagged wheels
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          path: dist
+          merge-multiple: true
+          pattern: deepep-v25-wheel-*
+
+      - name: Upload release assets
+        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
+        with:
+          tag_name: ${{ env.RELEASE_TAG }}
+          repository: sgl-project/whl
+          token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_FOR_WHL_RELEASE }}
+          fail_on_unmatched_files: true
+          files: dist/*.whl
+
+      - name: Clone wheel index
+        env:
+          WHL_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_FOR_WHL_RELEASE }}
+        run: |
+          git clone --branch gh-pages \
+            "https://oauth2:${WHL_TOKEN}@github.com/sgl-project/whl.git" sgl-whl
+
+      - name: Update wheel index
+        run: |
+          python3 scripts/update_deepep_whl_index.py \
+            --cuda 134 \
+            --package sgl-deep-ep-v25 \
+            --release-tag-prefix sgl-deep-ep-v25-v
+
+      - name: Push wheel indexes
+        env:
+          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
+        run: |
+          cd sgl-whl
+          git config --local user.name "sglang-bot"
+          git config --local user.email "sglangbot@gmail.com"
+          git add -A
+          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
+            echo "Wheel indexes are already up to date"
+          else
+            git commit -m "update sgl-deep-ep-v25 whl indexes for v${RELEASE_VERSION}"
+            git push origin gh-pages
+          fi
+
+  release-pypi:
+    needs: build-cu134-matrix
+    if: |
+      github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang' &&
+      needs.build-cu134-matrix.result == 'success'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - name: Download PyPI wheels
+        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          path: dist-pypi
+          merge-multiple: true
+          pattern: deepep-v25-pypi-cu134-*
+
+      - name: Upload to PyPI
+        env:
+          TWINE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SGL_DEEP_EP_V25_PYPI_TOKEN }}
+          TWINE_USERNAME: __token__
+        run: |
+          python3 -m pip install --upgrade twine "packaging>=24.2"
+          python3 -m twine upload --skip-existing dist-pypi/*.whl

@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+ARG BASE_IMAGE=pytorch/manylinux2_28-builder
+ARG CUDA_VERSION=13.4
+
+FROM ${BASE_IMAGE}:cuda${CUDA_VERSION}
+
+ARG ARCHITECTURE=x86_64
+ARG CUDA_TAG=cu134
+ARG CUDA_VERSION=13.4
+ARG NCCL_VERSION=2.32.3
+ARG PYTHON_TAG=cp312-cp312
+ARG TORCH_CUDA_TAG=cu130
+ARG TORCH_VERSION=2.14.1
+
+ENV CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda
+ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib:/usr/local/lib64:/usr/local/cuda/lib64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH}
+ENV PATH=/opt/python/${PYTHON_TAG}/bin:${PATH}
+ENV PYTHON_BIN=/opt/python/${PYTHON_TAG}/bin/python
+
+# DeepEP 2.5 has no NVSHMEM or RDMA build dependency. DeepJIT needs C++20 with <format>
+# (the builder images put gcc-toolset-13 first on PATH) and the elfutils headers; libdw
+# itself is only dlopen'ed at runtime.
+RUN yum install -y --nogpgcheck \
+        curl \
+        elfutils-devel \
+        git \
+        make \
+        patchelf \
+        pkgconfig \
+        wget \
+    && yum clean all \
+    && rm -rf /var/cache/yum
+
+RUN set -eux; \
+    if [ "${ARCHITECTURE}" = aarch64 ]; then cuda_target=sbsa; else cuda_target="${ARCHITECTURE}"; fi; \
+    cuda_stub="/usr/local/cuda-${CUDA_VERSION}/targets/${cuda_target}-linux/lib/stubs/libcuda.so"; \
+    test -f "${cuda_stub}"; \
+    mkdir -p /usr/lib64 "/usr/lib/${ARCHITECTURE}-linux-gnu"; \
+    ln -sf "${cuda_stub}" /usr/lib64/libcuda.so; \
+    ln -sf "${cuda_stub}" "/usr/lib/${ARCHITECTURE}-linux-gnu/libcuda.so"
+
+# PyTorch pins an older nvidia-nccl-cu13, so install the NCCL that DeepEP 2.5 needs over it.
+RUN --mount=type=cache,id=sgl-deep-ep-v25-pip-${CUDA_TAG}-${PYTHON_TAG}-${ARCHITECTURE},target=/root/.cache/pip \
+    set -eux; \
+    "${PYTHON_BIN}" -m pip uninstall -y deep-ep sgl-deep-ep sgl-deep-ep-v25 || true; \
+    "${PYTHON_BIN}" -m pip install --upgrade pip; \
+    "${PYTHON_BIN}" -m pip install --force-reinstall \
+        "torch==${TORCH_VERSION}" \
+        --index-url "https://download.pytorch.org/whl/${TORCH_CUDA_TAG}"; \
+    "${PYTHON_BIN}" -m pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps \
+        "nvidia-nccl-cu13==${NCCL_VERSION}"; \
+    "${PYTHON_BIN}" -m pip install \
+        "auditwheel>=6.0" \
+        build \
+        ninja \
+        packaging \
+        setuptools \
+        wheel; \
+    TORCH_VERSION="${TORCH_VERSION}" "${PYTHON_BIN}" -c \
+        'import os, torch; assert torch.__version__.startswith(os.environ["TORCH_VERSION"]); print(torch.__version__, torch.version.cuda)'; \
+    g++ --version | head -1; \
+    nvcc --version | tail -1

@@ -0,0 +1,182 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Build sgl-deep-ep-v25 (DeepEP 2.5, imported as `deep_ep_v25`) wheels in a
+# CUDA-versioned manylinux container.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   build_sgl_deepep_v25.sh <python-version> <cuda-version> <deepep-source> [architecture]
+#
+# Writes CUDA-tagged wheels to <deepep-source>/dist, plus PyPI-ready wheels
+# without the local CUDA version in <deepep-source>/dist-pypi.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+usage() {
+    cat <<'EOF'
+Usage: build_sgl_deepep_v25.sh <python-version> <cuda-version> <deepep-source> [architecture]
+
+  python-version:     3.11, 3.12, or 3.13
+  cuda-version:       13.4 (DeepEP 2.5 needs CUDA 13.1 or newer)
+  deepep-source:      DeepEP checkout containing the sgl_deep_ep_v25 package (sgl-deepep-v25)
+  architecture:       x86_64 or aarch64 (defaults to the current machine)
+
+Set SGL_DEEP_EP_V25_VERSION to override the checked-in package version.
+EOF
+}
+
+if [[ $# -lt 3 || $# -gt 4 ]]; then
+    usage >&2
+    exit 2
+fi
+
+PYTHON_VERSION="$1"
+CUDA_VERSION="$2"
+DEEPEP_SOURCE="$(cd "$3" && pwd)"
+ARCHITECTURE="${4:-$(uname -m)}"
+
+if [[ "${ARCHITECTURE}" == arm64 ]]; then
+    ARCHITECTURE=aarch64
+fi
+
+case "${PYTHON_VERSION}" in
+    3.11|3.12|3.13) ;;
+    *)
+        echo "Unsupported Python version: ${PYTHON_VERSION}" >&2
+        exit 2
+        ;;
+esac
+
+case "${CUDA_VERSION}" in
+    13.4)
+        CUDA_TAG=cu134
+        ;;
+    *)
+        echo "Unsupported CUDA version: ${CUDA_VERSION}" >&2
+        exit 2
+        ;;
+esac
+
+case "${ARCHITECTURE}" in
+    x86_64)
+        BASE_IMAGE=pytorch/manylinux2_28-builder
+        ;;
+    aarch64)
+        BASE_IMAGE=pytorch/manylinuxaarch64-builder
+        ;;
+    *)
+        echo "Unsupported architecture: ${ARCHITECTURE}" >&2
+        exit 2
+        ;;
+esac
+
+for required_file in setup.py deep_ep/__init__.py sgl_deep_ep_v25/build_sgl_deep_ep_v25.sh sgl_deep_ep_v25/setup.py sgl_deep_ep_v25/VERSION; do
+    if [[ ! -f "${DEEPEP_SOURCE}/${required_file}" ]]; then
+        echo "DeepEP source is missing ${required_file}: ${DEEPEP_SOURCE}" >&2
+        exit 1
+    fi
+done
+if ! command -v docker >/dev/null; then
+    echo "docker is required to build sgl-deep-ep-v25" >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+PYTHON_TAG="cp${PYTHON_VERSION//.}-cp${PYTHON_VERSION//.}"
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
